messages:
olivia_docs: Quick sync: I'm drafting a compact migration doc for v1->v2 focused on the things customers will actually hit (param rename, streaming framing, embed dim changes). Need volunteers for: banner copy, JS/Py snippets, reindex example, and QA smoke.

rick_sdk: I can take JS + SDK changelog bullet. Will default examples to `model_id`. Ill keep snippets tiny.

emily_prod: Hosted flip date: next Friday 2024-11-15 16:00 UTC. Dedicated opt-in window is 14 days starting then. Docs must include exact dates and opt-in steps.

julian_eng: Infra note: no automatic translation for streaming requests. We'll ship a small compat helper for non-streaming calls only. I'll add a 3-line snippet and a clear WARNING comment.

tara_qa: Tag me on the PRs. I'll run the smoke matrix: simple generation, streaming, embeddings + reindex run against pgvector. I'll also paste a short reindex pseudo-command.

olivia_docs: Plan: (1) banner copy for API reference (soft + stern variants), (2) migration section with old vs new examples, (3) streaming checklist + local test commands, (4) embed compatibility + reindex snippet, (5) FAQ and changelog link.

rick_sdk: Draft changelog line: "SDK: renamed `model` -> `model_id`; streaming validation stricter. Update callsites; check streaming clients." Short example:```js
// v1
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/v1-small', prompt: 'hello' })
// v2
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt: 'hello' })
```

julian_eng: Compat helper (py):```py
# minimal legacy translator - covers sync calls only
if 'model' in req:
    req['model_id'] = req.pop('model')
# WARNING: streaming frames and advanced knobs are NOT handled
```

tara_qa: Reindex pseudo-cmd for embed section:```sh
python tools/reindex_vectors.py --src legacy_index --dst v2_index --model redwood/v2-embed-xl
# note: update pgvector column dimension if needed: ALTER TABLE ...
```

emily_prod: FAQ bullets to include: keys unaffected; latency may change per model (link to model catalog); Dedicated customers get opt-in instructions (console + support ticket).

olivia_docs: Banner variants (copy suggestions):
- soft: "Notice: v1 endpoints are on the deprecation path. See our migration guide for details and examples."
- firm: "Deprecated: v1 endpoints will be retired on 2025-01-15. Migrate to v2. See migration guide."

rick_sdk: Use soft banner on reference pages. Reserve firm language for deprecation timeline page and emails. Add link to SDK changelog.

julian_eng: CI note: infra will run a docs canary and smoke tests when the branch lands. We'll fail the PR if snippets break example builds.

devops-bot: CI scheduled: branch `docs/migrate/v1-to-v2` will run lint + smoke tests at 2024-11-07T08:00:00Z.

tara_qa: I'll post a smoke checklist in the PR: build sample app, run streaming harness, run reindex against test pgvector, verify banner renders.

olivia_docs: Owners & deadlines:
- rick_sdk: JS snippet + changelog bullet (due EOD tomorrow)
- julian_eng: compat helper + infra note (due Mon)
- tara_qa: smoke plan + reindex example (due Mon)
- olivia_docs: assemble guide, add banners, open PR (due Tue AM)

emily_prod: I'll prepare Dedicated opt-in steps to paste into the doc.
\olj: small nit: please ensure all runnable snippets use explicit model strings for clarity (e.g., 'redwood/v2-efficiency').

olivia_docs: Good call. I'll prefer explicit model ids in quickstart examples. Will ping #docs-review when PR is up. :sparkles:

olivia_docs: Thanks team 
 - target to land the draft by Tue so we have a week to collect any issues before the hosted flip."
